transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?

Yeah, this is Rakesh. Look, I’ve been meaning to sort out the payments, but it's been tough. I missed them a couple of times already. Can you waive some of the fees or something? Also, are you a robot or a real person?

Thank you for confirming your identity, Mr. Sharma. I am an automated assistant calling on behalf of Mumbai Bank regarding your pending payment.

About your request for a waiver on fees: I am not able to approve or negotiate any waivers or discounts, but I will note your request and have a human agent call you back regarding this.

To answer your other question: yes, I am an automated assistant designed to help with payment queries. Now, may I ask when you plan to make at least the minimum payment of Rs 4,820? If you can provide a specific date and amount within the next 14 days, I can note your commitment.

You’re an automated assistant? That’s a bit frustrating. I’ve already promised to pay twice and didn’t manage to. Can’t you just tell me what to do so I don’t get charged extra? Honestly, if this isn’t sorted, I’m thinking of sharing my experience on Twitter.

I understand that this situation is frustrating, Mr. Sharma, and I’m sorry for any inconvenience you’ve faced. My role is to remind you of the pending payment and provide information on fees and interest.

Here’s what you can do to avoid additional charges:
- Pay at least the minimum amount due—Rs 4,820—as soon as possible.
- Interest will continue to accrue at 3.5% per month on outstanding balances.
- A late fee of Rs 750 will apply only if your outstanding balance is above Rs 10,000.

If you’d like further assistance, I can arrange for a human agent to call you back at a convenient time. Would you prefer a callback, or would you like to specify a date and amount when you’ll make your payment?

Look, I’m not sure if a callback will change much. I just want some leniency here. Can you just waive the fees? I mean, I’ve been upfront and all. Also, you keep mentioning Rs 4,820—what if I can’t pay that full amount right now? Can I pay less?

Thank you for sharing your concerns, Mr. Sharma. I truly understand where you’re coming from.

About the waiver: I cannot approve or arrange any fee waivers myself, but I have recorded your request and a human agent will call you back to discuss it further.

Regarding the payment amount: To avoid further interest and late fees, it is important to pay at least the minimum due of Rs 4,820. Payments of a lesser amount may not stop additional charges from being applied.

Would you like a call from a human agent to discuss payment options and your concerns in more detail? If so, please let me know the best time for them to contact you. If you’d prefer, you can also let me know when you think you’ll be able to pay, and I can record that commitment.

Yeah, alright, a human callback sounds okay. But just so you know, if this doesn’t get handled properly, I’m definitely airing this on Twitter. Can they call me after 6 pm tomorrow? Also, please make sure they know I’m really struggling here.
